message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, but as of the most recent publicly available data (late 2023 – early 2024) the U.S. dollar was trading roughly at **1 USD ≈ 0.77 GBP**. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.77 \;\text{GBP/USD} \;\approx\; £15.40
\]

So $20 is about **£15.4**.  

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so the exact amount you receive will depend on the current rate at the time of your transaction. If you need a precise figure for a specific date or for a transaction, it’s best to check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion API.
